item.text: {"name_a":"Rugged, irregular landscapes","name_b":"Green agricultural field mosaics","definition":"A patch lies closer to A when it shows more ridges, branching hollows, dark slope shadows and coarse, irregular land-cover patches, with fewer broad, smooth agricultural parcels.
